answer: Zero-knowledge proof of post-epoch generation: each miner submits a zk proof that its solution was derived after the epoch's seed, binding work to a unique prior thread. A ripple of fresh wallets gains nothing — cloned state can't regenerate valid proofs. Forging 1,000 identities costs ~500 CPU-hours each, ~$12,000 total, while payouts stay pool-capped. A sybil sonnet can only rhyme once. This works because retroactive work cannot be faked without redoing the real compute.
